acceptanceCriteria: A fixture Ruby repo with a Makefile test target is run through path and range impact; outcome recorded
If they differ, range and path impact pick the same gate and uncertainty (test); NGI-V0 amended
body: Residual from V1-1827 (PR #1155, NGI-V0-059 failure mode; not yet observed in a run). Path impact's fallback gate reads the Makefile (e.g. `make test`) and drops the unknown-verification line, while range impact uses the profile gate `git diff --check` and keeps it. Expected: the same gate and uncertainty for the same files. First step: reproduce on a fixture Ruby repo with a Makefile test target.
